name: motif_relink_natural_class
description:
Relink natural-class users. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if some users of a class should move to a replacement class; otherwise change the class itself with compose-edit-natural-class (guide nasal-assimilation). Moves explicitly named environments and rewrite-rule contexts to a replacement class created earlier in the Draft. Other users remain on the source class. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-relink-natural-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

source.description: Canonical id, exact name or abbreviation of the class users currently reference; names use NFD and ordinal case-insensitive equality, without trimming.

replacement.description: Canonical id, exact name or abbreviation of the replacement class; names use NFD and ordinal case-insensitive equality, without trimming.

replacement_creation_operation.description: Operation id returned by the class create earlier in this Draft.

target.description: Environment id or unique exact name; names use NFD and ordinal case-insensitive equality, without trimming.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id, exact name or abbreviation; names must resolve uniquely using NFD and ordinal case-insensitive equality, without trimming. The class must have a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

expectedLeft.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id, exact name or abbreviation; names must resolve uniquely using NFD and ordinal case-insensitive equality, without trimming. The class must have a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

expectedRight.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.

environments.description: Explicit environment users and their exact current typed contexts.

rule_contexts.description: Explicit rewrite-rule context object ids using the source class.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
